title: React Server Components directives resources and server functions
concepts: React Server Components render in a separate server or build environment before client bundling. They can access server-side data and keep server-only dependencies out of the client bundle.
Server Components and Client Components describe execution boundaries, not whether HTML is ever rendered on a server. Client Components can still contribute to server-rendered HTML in frameworks.

The 'use client' directive marks a module boundary; that module and its transitive dependencies belong to the client module subtree. Add the boundary where interactivity or browser-only capabilities are needed.
Server Components may be asynchronous and await data during rendering. They cannot use client-only state and Effect Hooks; client components handle interactivity.
Server Functions are async server-side functions exposed through a framework or bundler reference. Calling one from client code crosses a network boundary and serializes its arguments and result.
Server Function arguments are untrusted client input. The server must validate data and authorize every operation; a directive does not provide authentication or authorization.
React documents user-facing Server Components and Server Functions as stable in React 19, while the lower-level bundler/framework implementation APIs remain unstable across React 19 minor versions.
